free_tier.stated: No free tier. The IPv6-only plan is EUR 1.00 a month, EUR 11.99 a year: 1 vCPU (Intel Xeon E), 1 GB RAM, 10 GB SSD, 1 Gbit/s fair-share, no IPv4 at all (available as a paid add-on), one IPv6 address up to a /52. Three locations are listed and the stock differs by location: Frankfurt carries an 'Add to Cart' button, Amsterdam and Toronto carry 'Out of Stock'.

retention.stated: The terms give a 5-day grace period: 'Hop179 provides a 5 day grace period after the invoice is due. During this grace period, service will remain in a running state.' No deletion window past the grace period is stated on the page read.

egress.terms: 1 TB a month per the pricing page line 'Traffic 1 TB'; the port is 1 Gbit/s fair-share. No overage price is published and nothing states what happens past 1 TB.

interface_detail: Full root on a KVM guest, with a Proxmox web panel and VNC console, standard Linux distributions or a custom ISO, and weekly backups stated as included. Provisioning is manual: 'All VPSes are provisioned manually within a few hours. We do not use any automated provisioning system.'
tooling: any SSH client; Proxmox panel and VNC; no API documented. A free BGP session with AS11967 is offered, which is unusual at this price and makes it a candidate for a routed-prefix experiment rather than only a tunnel endpoint.
chaining: USD 1.119 a month at the annual term for 1 GB and 10 GB with a full /52 of IPv6, the largest IPv6 allocation, plus a free BGP session the only reason it is not the default pick is that two of its three locations are sold out and provisioning is manual.

limits.value: no IPv4 at all; 'IPv4: none (available as add-on)'. Access is over IPv6, or over an IPv4 address bought separately.
1 TB a month of traffic on a 1 Gbit/s fair-share port
manual provisioning: 'All VPSes are provisioned manually within a few hours', so a purchase is not instant

binding_note: No IPv4 address is included, so a client without IPv6 connectivity must buy the IPv4 add-on; the 1 TB allowance is the second constraint and the price is not one.

identity_cost.detail: no card at registration. The order flow's own signup step at my.hop179.net/order/signup/index/v6-vps collects Contact Information (First Name, Last Name, Company/Org., Title, Address 1, Address 2, City, State, Zip, Country, Phone, Email), a Tax ID/VATIN field, a 'VM Panel Password', then Authentication (username, password, confirm, optional recovery email). The only required identifiers beyond email are a name and a postal address; no card number, no ID document and no phone verification step is on the form, and no card hold or authorisation amount is stated. Payment rails per the terms: 'Payments are accepted via PayPal, Credit Card, and Bank Transfer.'

reliability_note: No reliability event observed. The vendor states weekly backups are included and runs its own AS11967 with PoPs at FRA, TOR, DUS, BAR, ZRH, SGP and AMS. No SLA is published.
confidence_note: the EUR 1.00 monthly and EUR 11.99 annual figures, the shape, the /52 IPv6 and the per-location stock markers are read today from the vendor's own order page, whose pricing select carries the term options as markup. The signup fields are read from the vendor's own signup page. The payment rails and the grace period are quoted from the vendor's terms page.

notes: Stock is the live constraint and it is location-specific, which is worth recording precisely: Amsterdam and Toronto were both marked 'Out of Stock' today while Frankfurt showed 'Add to Cart'. That is a single observation and the two sold-out locations could return. The monthly term at EUR 1.00 exists only on the Amsterdam plan, which is the sold-out one; Frankfurt's selector carries the annual term alone. So the headline figure of EUR 1.00 a month is a real published rate on a real plan, but the plan that is actually purchasable today is the annual one at EUR 11.99, which is USD 1.119 a month. The 'excl. VAT' note on the v6-vms page means an EU business buyer may see a higher gross figure; a private buyer outside the EU is not affected by that line as written. Not established: the IPv4 add-on price, whether UDP is blocked on any port, and the deletion window past the 5-day grace period. The vendor is an Estonian company, 'Hop179 OU' in the page title.

extras.term: 1 month, 3 months, 6 months or 1 year on Amsterdam; 1 year only on Frankfurt and Toronto
extras.price_arithmetic: Annual: EUR 11.99 a year / 12 = EUR 0.9992 a month, paid in one go; 0.9992 / 0.892784 = USD 1.1192, rounded to USD 1.119. Monthly alternative where offered: EUR 1.00 / 0.892784 = USD 1.1201. Rate: 1 USD = EUR 0.892784 (open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD, time_last_update_utc Sat, 24 Oct 2026 00:02:31 +0000). A VPS bills whether it runs or not, so 24/7 and 10 h/day are the same. Out of pocket for the first year: 11.99 / 0.892784 = USD 13.43.
extras.renewal_usd: same EUR 11.99 a year; no promotional price and no end date printed
extras.stock: Frankfurt in stock ('Add to Cart'); Amsterdam and Toronto out of stock ('Out of Stock'), all read from the vendor's own order page on 2026-10-24
